verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an API that apps can reach with access tokens, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on help.penpot.app returned 404 on every one. The API's existence, the plugin API and the MCP server are adjacent capabilities, not a published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
